nodes.label: idgham_mutajanisayn

nodes.note: near-makhraj pair merged; counterfactual: keep both letters distinct

nodes.label: idgham_shafawi
nodes.note: م + م merged into a held run; counterfactual: split the run (no idgham)

nodes.label: ikhfa
nodes.note: ں run of ~3 (nasalised, held); counterfactual: ں → ن (izhar) or run → 1

nodes.label: ikhfa_shafawi
nodes.note: م held before ب; counterfactual: shorten the hold / no ikhfa

nodes.label: istitaalah

nodes.note: clear ن before a throat letter; counterfactual: ن → ں (wrongly hidden)

nodes.label: izhar_shafawi

nodes.label: jahr
nodes.note: voiced letter; counterfactual: expect jahr vs hams

nodes.label: jawaz_wajhayn
